info.title: NextBookstore API
info.description: REST API of the bookstore. Prices are in dollars with two decimals. Errors always have the shape { error, code }. Authentication uses NextAuth session cookies: GET /api/auth/csrf, then POST /api/auth/callback/credentials (form fields csrfToken, email, password, json=true). The guest cart uses the bookstore_session_id cookie.
